scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @estara/api" "npm run dev -w @estara/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @estara/shared && npm run build -w @estara/api && npm run build -w @estara/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @estara/shared && npm run typecheck -w @estara/api && npm run typecheck -w @estara/web
